title: Enchong Dee embraces ‘yearner era’ with throwback photos of Erich Gonzales

blocks.text: Enchong Dee appears to have fully embraced his persona as “yearner.” The actor and TV host recently caught the attention of social media users after sharing a series of throwback photos with his former loveteam partner, Erich Gonzales over the weekend. “Ghost month pa rin?” Enchong wrote in the caption, accompanied by Ben&Ben’s “Lifetime (Reimagined).” The post quickly brought their former loveteam back into the spotlight, with fans revisiting the projects that made Enchong and Erich a popular tandem. The two first worked together in the 2009 ABS-CBN series “Katorse.” They later reunited in “I Do” in 2010 and “Once a Princess” in 2014. While their onscreen partnership ended years ago, Enchong has continued to occasionally revisit their old memories through social media. His latest post also fits into a running joke that the actor has seemingly embraced himself: his reputation as a professional “yearner.” Enchong has himself incorporated it into his social media persona through “Enchong Dee University,” a fictional institution built around his humorous posts and relationship-related “lessons.” The concept includes a tongue-in-cheek “yearning” program, with Enchong effectively presenting himself as a longtime student and/or professor of the art of longing. The running joke has allowed the actor to poke fun at his own social media habits, particularly posts that revisit old memories, relationships and emotional situations. His Erich posts have consequently become part of that larger online persona. However, while the “yearner” label is clearly something Enchong has learned to play along with, the actor has not publicly said that he wants to rekindle his relationship with Erich, who has been married for years now. Erich married businessman Mateo Lorenzo in 2022. She has also largely stayed away from mainstream showbiz following her last major television project, the ABS-CBN revenge drama series “La Vida Lena.” Enchong, meanwhile, remains active in entertainment, appearing in television and other projects while continuing to maintain a strong presence on social media.
